item.title: Help independent news: Pick March’s RPG Publisher Spotlight
item.description: The longest ever January is behind us, and we're speeding into the chocolate season of Valentine's Day (an excuse to buy chocolate) and Easter (also chocolate). In this post, our Patrons get to vote for a publisher that the blog and podcast will promote.

item.title: Swedish indie RPG Oceania 2084 wins Game of the Year
item.description: Oceania 2084 wins Game of the Year and Best Setting at the 2025 No Dice Unrolled awards, cementing its status as a top dystopian RPG from Swedish designer Johan Eriksson.

item.title: Teeth and Treachery: Exploring the Hex-Based World of Misbehave
item.description: Discover the charmingly grubby world of Goblin, a solo TTRPG prototype by Wojciech Rosiński and Hexy Studio where players recover a shattered crown.

item.title: From Frieren to Dan Da Dan: Crunchyroll Store unveils romantic picks
item.description: Crunchyroll reveals its February highlights alongside the viral Adopt-a-Shoggoth campaign, perfect for both anime lovers and fans of cosmic horror.

item.title: Occult City: Where pulp superheroes meet cosmic horror
item.description: Dog House Rules launches Occult City, a Savage Worlds setting mixing Golden Age heroes with cosmic horror. Download the free Jumpstart and back the Kickstarter now.

item.title: Shadowdark Compatible: Torches Ready
item.description: The torches last one hour. The monsters are hungry. Get seven third-party adventures and sourcebooks for the Shadowdark RPG in this new Bundle of Holding offer.

item.title: Night City comes to life with new Cyberpunk RED battle mat sets
item.description: Loke Battle Mats launches a new range of officially licensed Cyberpunk RED accessories, including lay-flat maps and dedicated chase packs for the Dark Future.

item.title: A Sparkling Debut: First impressions of Idols of the Neon Dark
item.description: Explore our first look at Idols of the Neon Dark, a K-Pop-inspired D&D 5E+ project. Check out the new Idol class and the neon-soaked streets of Lumenica.

item.title: Watch the off-the-chain trailer for psychological horror ‘Exit 8’
item.description: The trailer's just dropped for psychological horror Exit 8, based on the indie video game The Exit 8 - and it looks like it's going to be an unsettling but wild ride.

item.title: Half of Japan’s samurai were women, according to new British Museum exhibition
item.description: A groundbreaking exhibition at the British Museum reveals that half of the samurai class were women and explores their impact on modern geek culture.
